subtitle: Stage 2 Target-Mirrored Extraction · Visual Confirmation Gallery

notices.title: 8 USM Video Cutscenes Demuxed with Web-Playable MP4 & PNG Thumbnails
notices.message: Demuxed proprietary VP9 IVF video payloads from all 8 CRI USM guide videos and UI animations. Extracted high-resolution PNG video thumbnails for card grid rendering and transcoded to H.264 MP4 with faststart headers for in-browser video playback within the modal lightbox.

notices.title: 160 Japanese Voicelines Voiced by Horie Yui (堀江由衣) Extracted
notices.message: All 160 Japanese voice lines across dialog storylines, combat encounters, system cues, and interactive scenes voiced by Horie Yui (堀江由衣) were extracted with verified ChaCha20 chunk offsets and custom XOR-stream PCK container decoders. Audio streams natively in browser via the local transcoding server.

notices.title: Dual Identity Resolution: Laevatain (Endfield) & Surtr (Arknights)
notices.message: Complete probing executed across all character naming conventions: Character ID chr_0016_laevat (chapter tag c16), alter ego Surtr (スルト / 史尔特尔 / 수르特), assigned alias Olga Randall (UWST Beacon DAU.14), and phantom / montage combat variants (npc_chr_0016_laevat_phantom, npc_chr_0016_laevat_red_a_01).

notices.title: 630 Non-Japanese Voice Lines Cataloged Out of Scope
notices.message: Per user scope instructions, only Japanese audio voiced by Horie Yui is in scope. 630 voice lines across English (Kira Buckland), Chinese (Yan Meme), and Korean (Kum You-rim) were probed in PCK blocks A31457D0, E1E7D7CE, and E9D31017, and are cataloged in meta/manifest.json and meta/audio_catalog.json as out of scope.

notices.title: 1,547 AssetBundle Records Mapped via Brotli-Decompressed manifest.hgmmap
notices.message: Discovered that Data/Bundles/Windows/manifest.hgmmap (159.6 MB uncompressed Brotli) contains high-confidence mappings for 1,547 character assets (201 FBX meshes, 142 PNG textures, 232 animations, 204 prefabs, 457 Unity scriptable objects). Documented in meta/manifest.json for Stage 2/Stage 3 follow-up.
